Agent Name: DataAnalysis_Expert  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The DataAnalysis_Expert initially states results based on a mock dataset rather than using verified, actual historical weather data. They report the number of rainy days for each year during the first week of September as consistently high (6-7 days out of 7), which led to an incorrect calculation of a 96.43% probability of rain. This error was immediately apparent because the initial failure to procure actual data was clearly noted. The subsequent step verified this error when the correct dataset was loaded, revealing no rainy days, showing the initial claim was inaccurate. This discrepancy between mock data and actual data was not rectified before the results were shared, leading to a misleading conclusion.
